answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Median first divergence of 3.5 and edit distance of 0.613 fit fine-tuned (5.5-8 and 0.56-0.65) better than quantized (10-17) or system-prompted (0 and 0.79-0.82). KL 0.124 and top-1 agreement 0.939 are in the fine-tuned range. Layer-1 L2 of 0.086 sits at the fine-tuned low end, below the quantized 0.096-0.105. Layer-16 L2 of 0.162 and layer-32 L2 of 0.297 are also fine-tuned. Mid-layer size ratio of 1.018 (grows) matches fine-tuned, whereas quantized shrinks to 0.968. Direction consistency of 0.625 matches fine-tuned (0.618-0.705). The layer-2 spike of 1.2 rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). Effective rank 3.62 is slightly above the fine-tuned range but still nearer to it than to quantized.
